statements.t: (NASDAQ: BIOA) ("BioAge" or "the Company"), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapeutic product candidates for cardiometabolic diseases by targeting the biology of human aging, today provided business updates and reported its third quarter 2026 financial results.

Our Phase 2 cardiovascular study, QUELL-CV, is fully enrolled, and we expect the results later this year to inform the optimal dose and show how BGE-102 could affect a range of metabolic and inflammatory markers.
The Company intends to file its first IND for an APJ program by year-end 2026.
The Company also continued to progress its strategic collaboration with Lilly ExploR&D for the development of therapeutic antibodies targeting novel metabolic aging targets.
